title: Lapse in Insurance Coverage for Home Protection Scheme
what_it_is: Lapse in Insurance Coverage for Home Protection Scheme

sections.label: HPS lapses and appeals
sections.summary: Under the CPF Act, HDB flat owners using CPF savings for mortgage instalments must take up HPS; about 1.5% lapsed in December 2016, and CPFB received 19 appeals in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Under the CPF Act, it is mandatory for all HDB flat owners who use their CPF savings to pay for their mortgage instalments to take up HPS.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As at December 2016, about 1.5% of HDB flat owners who used CPF savings for their mortgage instalments lapsed on their HPS policy because they failed to pay the insurance premiums.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This was lower than the corresponding figure of about 1.6% in 2015 and 1.8% in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In 2016, CPFB received 19 appeals from family members who requested to make a HPS claim even though the deceased policy holder had lapsed or cancelled his HPS policy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: CPF Board and HDB have put in place several measures to help HDB flat owners minimise the risk of lapsing on their HPS coverage.

sections.label: HPS coverage and premium review
sections.summary: HPS covers members with mild pre-existing illnesses, and MOM is reviewing extension to serious pre-existing conditions while exploring ways to strengthen premium payment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Today, HPS already covers members with mild pre-existing illnesses, such as well-controlled diabetes and hypertension.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM is reviewing the extension of HPS to those who suffer from serious pre-existing medical conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Sam Tan Chin Siong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We are also exploring with MND and HDB on how we can further strengthen the continued payment of HPS insurance premium to minimise the number of HPS lapses.
